findings.heading: Download offline handbook / Descargar el manual sin conexión
findings.proposition: English gives the download location for the offline handbook: right-click https://github.com/appliedepi/epirhandbook/raw/main/offline_long/index.html and select "Save link as". The Spanish section contains no link and no download instruction at all.
findings.reader_consequence: A Spanish reader is told the offline handbook exists and what to expect from it, but is given no way to obtain it. The stated purpose of the section cannot be carried out.

findings.heading: Download offline handbook / Descargar el manual sin conexión
findings.proposition: English states the platform-specific alternatives for saving the link: Cmd+click on a Mac, press and hold then "Save link" on mobile. The Spanish section states neither.
findings.reader_consequence: Mac and mobile readers have no equivalent of the right-click action, so they cannot reproduce the download step on their device.

findings.heading: Download offline handbook / Descargar el manual sin conexión
findings.proposition: English states that a screen of raw HTML code means the instructions were not followed correctly. The Spanish section omits this troubleshooting statement.
findings.reader_consequence: A Spanish reader who lands on a raw HTML page has no signal that this is a wrong-path symptom, and may assume the handbook file itself is broken.

findings.heading: Download offline handbook / Descargar el manual sin conexión
findings.proposition: The Spanish considerations list carries a fourth bullet instructing the reader to install the appliedepidata R package, which contains all example data, as a step to take for offline use. The English list has three bullets and makes no such instruction here.
findings.reader_consequence: The reader is given an offline-preparation step the English does not prescribe. It is plausible advice, but it is not the source text and it presents package installation as part of the offline-handbook procedure rather than as the separate data section that follows.

findings.heading: Flexdashboard
findings.proposition: English states that the flexdashboard files are R Markdown/HTML source files, not example datasets, so they are not part of the appliedepidata package and must be downloaded directly from Github. The Spanish sentence states only that links to the associated file follow.
findings.reader_consequence: A Spanish reader may search appliedepidata with get_data() or search_data() for the dashboard files, find nothing, and conclude the package or the handbook is incomplete.

findings.heading: Contact Tracing / Rastreo de contactos
findings.proposition: English states that the Go.Data contact tracing data is not part of appliedepidata. The Spanish sentence omits that statement and goes straight to the download links.
findings.reader_consequence: A Spanish reader may try to load the contact tracing data with appliedepidata::get_data() instead of using the supplied .rds download links, and will not find it.
